# Changelog — Venue

## 0.4.1

- Connecting another app shows its NPS points on the button; without enough points the button says how many are needed.

## 0.4.0

- Connect Shopping and choose your purchasing list: the reports show what was bought each month next to your takings. Connect your Cookbook and add a recipe to the menu with its name, ingredients and allergens filled in.

## 0.3.0

- Design your menu: place up to 5 pictures on an A4 page, drag and size them, choose the font, colours, a panel behind the texts and one or two columns. Saving turns the pictures into one background; print the menu from the print view, and show the same design on your online menu.

## 0.2.0

- Tables with QR stickers to print: on your tablet or phone a table's sticker opens its order;
  guests who scan it see your menu.
- Take orders at the table, search the menu as you type, and tick off what was brought. The floor
  shows every table, what is still to bring and the amount so far.
- Each seating gets its own bill QR: guests see their whole order without an account, what is
  still coming, the VAT, the tip they choose and the total.
- Finalise a bill with cash, card or other: the table is free again and the bill's code stops
  working. Bills are deleted after six months; the sales numbers stay.
- Staff switch in on a tablet with their PIN. New reports: sales and income by day and month,
  tips, the best-selling items, and a search through the bills.
- Search bars on the menu, the menu editor, the floor and the tables.

## 0.1.0

- The first version, for cafés, bistros, fast food places and bars. Set up your venue with its
  country: Hungary and Romania come with their currency and VAT rates ready, any other country
  is set up by hand.
- Build your menu: categories, then items with the price, the VAT rate, where they are prepared
  and the 14 allergens. Mark an item sold out with one tick.
- Add your staff with a role and a PIN, and enable your shared tablets. Only you, the owner, see
  these settings; a lost tablet can be disabled at once.
- Your guests can read the menu online, for example from a QR code on the tables.
- Choose how tips work on the bill: switched off, a few percentages of the bill before VAT for
  the guest to pick (15, 20 and 25 % to start with), or a fixed tip.
